item.title: [News] Red-teaming a network of agents: Understanding what breaks when AI agents interact at scale
item.description: Microsoft Research is studying the risks associated with interactions between multiple AI agents, which could lead to unforeseen breakdowns in the system even when individual agents are safe. This research has implications for the development and deployment of AI-powered systems in the future.

item.title: [News] Enabling a new model for healthcare with AI co-clinician
item.description: Google DeepMind is researching the development of an AI co-clinician, a new model for healthcare that enables AI-augmented care. This innovation matters to IT practitioners as it highlights the potential of AI to transform industries beyond pure tech.

item.title: [News] Four ways Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance
item.description: Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance, a technique to improve research efficiency. This matters to an IT practitioner as it showcases advancements in data mining and modeling that could influence future AI tools and technologies.

item.title: [News] Unlocking human ambition to drive business growth with AI
item.description: Microsoft announces that customers are using AI to drive business growth, particularly by unlocking creativity and democratizing intelligence through the use of Copilots and agents. This matters to IT practitioners as it highlights the potential of AI to transform business operations.

item.title: [News] Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud scales to thousands of nodes with Azure Local
item.description: Microsoft has announced that its Azure Local can now support up to thousands of servers, enabling organizations to run larger workloads locally across multiple datacenter, industrial, and edge locations. This update is particularly relevant to IT practitioners working on large-scale deployments and datacenter management.
